scope: Proposition 3.8 (Preparation at rest) of the manuscript “A Charged Reduction of the Spacetime Penrose Inequality in Spatial Dimensions at Least Four” (preprints/A-Charged-Reduction-of-the-Spacetime-Penrose-Inequality-in-Spatial-Dimensions-at-Least-Four-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3e5e445d305051a1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose the original data have a future-timelike ADM vector, and set m = (E2 ADM − |PADM|2)1/2 > 0. Choose once and for all n − 2 2 < q < n − 2, 0 < β < min{1, q}, weakening the original decay exponent if necessary. There is a sequence of smooth data on the same exterior, with the same electric flux form and charge, satisfying Kj is compactly supported, gj − δ = Ol(r2−n ) for every l, (3.15) Rgj = O(r−n−β ), µm,j − |Jm,j|gj ≥ cjr−n−β , Hj + ϵa trSa,gj Kj < 0, where cj > 0. Its momentum vanishes and EADM(gj, Kj) −→ m, lim inf j→∞ a(gj) ≥ a(g). (3.16) The same conclusion holds with a fixed compactly supported closed Dm, provided the original data are already future-timelike, have strict trapping, and satisfy a strict charged margin µm − |Jm| ≥ cr−n−β for some c > 0. The constants and support radii in (3.15) need not be uniform in j.
